main_text.l: Antequam vocalium puncta à Maforethis in-
venta sunt, tres quiescentes ו א omnium vo-
calium vices supplebant, unde matres lectionis
dicebantur: א indicabat Pathach & Camets.
ו o & u; scil. cholem, camets chatuph, schurec,
& kibbuts. erat pro e & i; scil. pro tfere, se-
gol, & utroque chirec. Jod etiam chateph-segol
vocalem breviffimam annotabat & aliquando fim-
plex fcheva.
Hinc fit, ut post inventa & superaddita voca-
lium puncta, relictis illis consonis quae vocalium
erant indices confusa extiterit punctatio, tum in
Targumim seu paraphrasibus Chaldaicis (quae
confusio quum in Venetis, tum in Regiis Bibliis
passim invenitur, & summo labore Buxtorfii in
Bibliis Basilienf. sublata est) tum in variis scri-
pturae locis, ut Pfalm. 77.10. ubi in [illegible, ~4 letters] Jod
post Lamed, quod non pluralem numerum sed
scheva denotabat, post additam vocalem relictu
est; sic etiam Pfalm. 120. 5. [illegible, ~3 letters] pro [illegible, ~3 letters], ubi
ו non Shurec sed Kibbuts sequente daghes
secundum analogiam denotaret: vide Lud. de
Dieu. Gram. l. 1. c. 7. Sixtinum Amam. & alios,
praecipue librum eruditissimum Lud. Capelli ab
Erpenio editum, Punctationis arcanum revela-
tum inscriptum, cujus lectio cordatos omne-
s (paucis quibusdam pervicacibus exceptis) in su-
am sententiam de punctorum & accentuum no-
vitate adduxit; quae vero nuper edidit vir qui-
dam doctus contra Capelli Arcanum, ita jejuna &
frigida sunt, ut paucos (nisi fallor) sibi confen-
tientes habeat.
Cholem cum supra ו notatur sic [illegible, ~1 letter], dicitur Vau

page.notes: Printed page number is "(9)" at the head, centred. No running head. Hebrew and Hebrew-pointed words are only partly legible at this scan resolution; they are marked illegible rather than guessed. The vav glyph "1" in "1 non Shurec" and "supra 1 notatur" is read as ו with [?] omitted because the form is clear. Signature "D 5" at the lower left is slightly blurred. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. The catchword "Cholem" is printed at the right foot.
